weighing.title: Net weighing
weighing.description: Record only the net weight of materials in kg. The warehouse provides the expected weight and tolerance; material units are not converted to kg.
weighing.forbidden: Your account does not have permission to access weighing.
weighing.loadError: Data could not be refreshed. If the save confirmation is shown, the weighing was already recorded. Refresh to view the history.
weighing.vehicleError: The vehicle could not be loaded or assigned. Refresh the data before trying again.
weighing.closed: New weighings can only be recorded while the dispatch is in preparation.
weighing.needVehicle: Assign a vehicle before recording the weighing.
weighing.precision: Complete all three values in kg, with up to three decimal places. Tolerance is an absolute margin and can be zero.
weighing.empty: No weighings have been recorded yet.
weighing.pending: A submission is awaiting confirmation. Its values and identifier are retained to retry without duplicating it, including after a page reload.
weighing.invalid: Enter positive weights and a nonnegative tolerance, with up to three decimal places and a maximum of 999999999.999 kg.
weighing.storageError: The browser cannot store the submission identifier. Enable session storage before continuing.
weighing.uncertain: The submission result could not be confirmed. Use Retry the same weighing to check or complete that same operation.
weighing.conflict: The dispatch changed or the request conflicts with an existing record. Refresh and check the history before submitting another weighing.
weighing.saveError: The server rejected the weighing. Refresh the data, verify the values and try again.
weighing.stale: This weighing belongs to an earlier load or vehicle; a new weighing is needed.

guide.title: Dispatch guide
guide.description: The warehouse confirms the load, weighing and carrier before authorizing the dispatch.
guide.requirements: An in-preparation dispatch, assigned vehicle and current weighing within tolerance are required. Check the weighing before continuing.
guide.confirmation: Confirming saves the materials, vehicle and weighing in the guide. To correct them afterwards, cancel the dispatch and prepare a new one.
guide.locked: The issued guide preserves the load, vehicle and weighing; these values can no longer be changed on this dispatch.
guide.issued: Guide issued and dispatch authorized. Departure must still be recorded when the vehicle leaves the warehouse.
guide.departHint: Confirm only when the vehicle is leaving. The dispatch will move to In transit.
guide.departed: Departure recorded. The dispatch is in transit.
guide.loadError: Data could not be refreshed. If issuance was already confirmed, the guide remains saved; refresh to view it.
guide.invalid: Enter driver and carrier names, up to 150 characters and without line breaks.
guide.saveError: The guide could not be issued. Refresh the dispatch and check the values before continuing.
guide.conflict: The dispatch changed, already has a guide or does not meet the requirements. Review the refreshed data.
guide.pending: A guide issuance is awaiting confirmation. Its exact details are retained to retry without duplicating the guide.
guide.uncertain: The response could not be confirmed. Retry the same issuance to check or complete that operation.
guide.storageError: Enable browser session storage to retain the submission identifier.
guide.departureError: Departure could not be confirmed. Review the refreshed status before repeating the action.
